locations.note: German diver Ernst is caught in the Battle of Jutland, saves drowning sailors as his own boat goes down, and is picked up by the blockade-running submarine Germania.
The Germania docks in neutral Baltimore, where Ernst befriends dock worker James, Freddie's brother, over their love of music.
Aboard U-155 Ernst deliberately misses the troop ship carrying James; later he sabotages the U-boat's torpedoes, and it is sunk and he is captured.

Freddie teams up with British pilot George at the Battle of Vimy Ridge, Anna comes to train British medics, and George follows a German spy through a tunnel to the enemy lines and escapes in a stolen plane.
Anna nurses the wounded in the town's hospital when the Germans bomb it; James's Harlem Hellfighters arrive and he is reunited with Freddie.
After holding the line in the spring offensive, the Harlem Hellfighters perform a jazz concert in Paris.
In the Meuse–Argonne offensive Freddie is badly wounded protecting James, and George flies him to Anna's field hospital.
